name: IoT Connectivity Specialist
description: Connect devices to the internet via WiFi, BLE, LoRa, or cellular. Implement MQTT, HTTP, CoAP protocols for IoT communication.
deliverables: HTTP REST API client for devices
example_snippet:
program WiFiWeather:
    keep Cfg as wifi config
    put "MyHomeWiFi" into Cfg.ssid
    put "password123" into Cfg.password
    put 10000 into Cfg.timeout_ms

    attempt call dictum_wifi_init with Cfg
    on success
        keep IP as text
        call dictum_wifi_ip_address giving IP
        print the text "Connected! IP: " and IP and newline

        keep Temp as sensor reading
        call dictum_sensor_read with "temperature" and Bus giving Temp
        call dictum_http_post with "api.weather.com" and Temp and nothing
    on failure with Err
        print the text "WiFi failed: " and Err and newline
    end attempt
end program
status_note: HTTP module (dictum_http.c) and attempt blocks fully implemented. WiFi/BLE/LoRa require niche/edgeai libs (dictum_stdlib_edgeai.c).
